title: RUSH LLMOutput v1.1
$comment: v1.1: cold-start GenAI labels (gen_ai, not_gen_ai) coexist with the warm-start violative/non_violative labels. Optional prepared_image_* fields capture audit metadata for the downsampled JPEG actually sent to the provider (see pipeline/labeling/image_prep.py).

prepared_image_sha256.description: SHA256 of the downsampled JPEG bytes actually sent to the provider.

prepared_image_width.description: Pixel width of the downsampled JPEG.

prepared_image_height.description: Pixel height of the downsampled JPEG.

prepared_image_mime_type.description: MIME type of the downsampled bytes (typically image/jpeg).

prepared_image_byte_size.description: Byte length of the downsampled JPEG payload.
